title: The song 'A La Ba' and the Creole language
summary: Nelson first heard 'A La Ba' sung by Billy and Dee Dee; Burbank recorded it; Nelson knows no Creole despite coming from St. Bernard.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
